confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of New Zealand pricing for a July (winter, lower-demand) window. Restaurant, coffee and bar anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by season and property. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. FX provenance is weak: the 2026-10-16 figure of 0.6947 USD_PER_AUD was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA, but the RBA page was not opened and the value could not be checked against the official F11.1 table. Verify it against rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single direct comparable. Benchmarked to general New Zealand urban pricing, with Wellington's café and restaurant scene and its winter low season for accommodation considered. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about twice the beer price, wine glass about one and a third times) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
